svg.title: SINBIN live match mobile UI v0.1 wireframe
svg.desc: An exact 844 by 390 landscape mobile layout showing the score, resolution count, live Pressure, Chain and Threat, disruption countdown, three active role cards, three bench cards and two mutually exclusive emergency actions. Violetta is selected on the bench, and the three active destinations preview Direct, Bridge and Breaks Chain outcomes.

g.text: LIVE FEED · THE VICE COLLAPSES HIGH

g.aria-label: Active line with substitution destination preview
